blind.description: A stylized wooden confessional booth or cabinet crafted with hand-painted textures. The top has flat outer ledges flanking a raised, curved central pediment. The front features three compartments framed by decorative wooden pilasters: a center hinged door with a wooden knob and a short gathered red curtain valance above it, flanked by two side cubicles draped in full-length dark red pleated curtains. The exterior wooden side panels are recessed, and all surfaces are solid, continuous, and sit flush on the floor.
blind.from_above: A rectangular wooden surface with a raised convex barrel-arched central section flanked by two flat rectangular side ledges.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 4.8 to 5.0 feet tall (reaching roughly shoulder-to-neck height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 5 feet wide.
